purpose: Prevent a compact applied playbook from appearing more verified than its evidence supports.

principles.rule: Broad quality/readiness claims must be decomposed into concrete invariants that can fail independently.
If an invariant can be checked mechanically from structured state, artifacts or reports, use deterministic/mechanical verification rather than model self-judgment.
Model judgment is reserved for genuinely semantic interpretation. It must not be relabeled deterministic.
A gate/readiness PASS is not strong evidence unless the checked invariant, result and evidence/provenance are explicit.
PASS with zero checked items, zero evaluated assertions, empty check_results/evidence, or non-applicable validation silently treated as success must not support READY_FOR_USE.
Critical invariants need at least one negative/failure scenario where practical, not only happy-path evidence.
Structural coverage, behavioral coverage and semantic confidence must be reported separately. Do not present structural reachability as behavioral proof.
Do not recreate stage explosion. Keep orchestration compact while moving detailed checks into deterministic reports or explicit invariant bundles.
Before readiness, compare accepted requirements/state against generated business and technical artifacts for contradictions and unsupported additions.

readiness_blockers: critical invariant has no verification method
mechanically-checkable critical invariant is verified only by unsupported model assertion
critical PASS has empty evidence/check results
vacuous PASS is used as readiness evidence
coverage report hides zero behavioral evaluation behind aggregate PASS
generated artifact adds unsupported business semantics
